brief: Trial NCT03433703 (Eisai, phase 2). Why did it stop and how many people were enrolled? Were results posted?

findings.claim: Trial NCT03433703 was terminated with the stated why_stopped reason: "Study recruitment was stopped due to difficulty in enrolling the targeted number of participants.", categorized as enrollment.
findings.notes: Confirmed via snapshot and live record.

findings.claim: Results were posted for trial NCT03433703 on ClinicalTrials.gov on December 6, 2019.
findings.notes: Results posted status is true, results_first_post_date is 2019-12-06.

tool_calls.name: get_trial_live
tool_calls.result: NCT03433703: TERMINATED, why_stopped='Study recruitment was stopped due to difficulty in enrolling the targeted number'

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.sponsor, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_posted, d.results_due_date, d.days_late FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT03433703'
